rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for causing someone or an animal severe physical or emotional suffering.

example.english: This illness continued to torment him for years.
example.traditional: 呢場病折磨咗佢好多年。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 beng6 zit3 mo4 zo2 keoi5 hou2 do1 nin4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for severe torment or suffering, especially when someone is being put through it.

example.english: The constant pain from this illness is torment for me.

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the intense suffering experienced rather than the act or treatment causing it.

example.english: The days after losing my close friend were intense torment for me.

rows.note: Use this specifically for deliberate physical torture, especially by authorities or with an instrument.

example.english: The report says the authorities inflicted torment through torture on the prisoner.
